headline: Approved energy assistance agreements for Keefe and Miller senior centers, a Generation Power CT memorandum, and a Connecticut Climate Superfund resolution.
summary: Director Bivens gave an overview of the energy assistance programs. Council member Figlar asked how they would be advertised, and Bivens said through the town website and social media.
decisions: Approved agreement with Community Action Agency of New Haven for the 2026-2027 energy assistance program at Keefe Community Center, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.
Approved agreement with Community Action Agency of New Haven for the 2026-2027 energy assistance program at Miller Senior Center, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.
Approved memorandum of understanding and authorized the mayor to sign the agreement with Generation Power CT, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.
Approved resolution supporting the establishment of a Connecticut Climate Superfund, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
HUMAN SERVICES 
COMMITTEE MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
Committee Co-Chairs: 
Present Maurine Crouch 
Present Tameeka Parks 
Committee Members: 
Present Sean Cardwell 
Present Ted Stevens 
Present Adrian Webber 
Present - Doug Foley 
Present - Tasha Hunt 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Absent - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President  
 
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Human Services Committee Meeting, September 28, 2026 – 7pm.  The meeting was 
opened by Co-Chair Crouch at 9:41pm with the members noted above in attendance.   
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION – On one came forward to speak 
No members of the public came forward to give public comment.  
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS –  
Chair Crouch mentioned the Boards/Commissions information on the agenda and invited 
residents to check online for information.  She also asked if anyone was interested in 
participating in a board or commission to contact the Council.  
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA 
Co-Chair Crouch called for a motion to bundle items 1, 2, and 3. 
The motion was made by Majority Leader Gallagher and seconded by Council member 
Parks.  
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Motion to bundle passed unanimously.   
  1. ORDER APPROVING AGREEMENT WITH COMMUNITY ACTION AGENCY OF 
NEW HAVEN FOR CONNECTICUT ENERGY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (CEAP) 
PROGRAM YEAR 2026-2027 KEEFE COMMUNITY CENTER 
  
  2. ORDER APPROVING AGREEMENT WITH COMMUNITY ACTION AGENCY OF 
NEW HAVEN FOR CONNECTICUT ENERGY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (CEAP) 
PROGRAM YEAR 2026-2027 MILLER SENIOR CENTER  
  3. ORDER APPROVING A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING AND 
AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO SIGN THE AGREEMENT GENERATION POWER 
CT 
 
Co-Chair Crouch then called for a motion to open items 1, 2, and 3.   
The motion was made by Council member Foley and seconded by Pro Tem 
Cardwell.   
 
Director Bivens provided a brief overview of the programs.  Council member Figlar 
asked how the programs would be advertised and Director Bivens noted through the 
town’s website and various social media. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Items 1, 2, and 3 passed unanimously.
4. RESOLUTION SUPPORTING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A CONNECTICUT 
CLIMATE SUPERFUND 
MOTION: Cardwell 
SECOND: Parks 
VOTE: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item 4 passed unanimously. 
  
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
None for this evening  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
None for this evening 
 
ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the Committee, Co-Chair Crouch adjourned the 
meeting at 9:52pm.
